# Review Mining

`review-mining` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Research & Personas
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/review-mining/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** What do buyers praise and complain about in our reviews and our rivals', and where can we claim an advantage with proof?

**Inputs:** Reviews of your product and one or more competitors, each with the product name, the star rating, the text and optionally the source, the date and your own theme coding

**Output:** Per product, each theme's share of reviews with a 95% interval and its praise and complaint counts; the opportunities where a rival is complained about and you are not; the theme to fix first; every switching sentence and feature ask; the phrases happy reviewers use; coverage of the coding; and a verdict

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill review-mining`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/review-mining/resources/review-miner.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/review-mining/resources/review-miner.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Reviews over-represent the delighted and the furious, so theme shares describe reviewers, not the market. It flags a single source; use two before generalising.
- Sentiment comes from the star rating only. A review with no rating is a mention, and a complaint inside a 4- or 5-star review counts as praise for that theme.
- The default word list covers twelve software themes and matches words, not meaning. Below 60% coverage or in a specialist category, add a lexicon or code by hand.
- Under 10 reviews of a product the intervals are too wide to compare. An opportunity is a lead to prove, not a claim the engine has checked.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns positioning spot-checks ten word-list-coded reviews and confirms you are provably better before claiming an opportunity. Legal or the content owner confirms consent before any reviewer's words appear in marketing.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/review-mining](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/review-mining)
